title: Design System: NAN DAY 4 Office Escape

display.purpose: Intro clock and title; use only for the immediate escape premise.

headline.purpose: HUD clock, outcome mark, and action label hierarchy.

label.purpose: Route zones, small status, and compact pickup marks.

shadows.name: hud-separation
shadows.purpose: Separates HUD from the moving world.

motion.name: runner-breath
motion.purpose: Subtle running motion for approved character art.

motion.name: telegraph-pulse
motion.purpose: Raises and brightens an upcoming obstacle cue.

components.name: Escape CTA
components.description: The intro and result action that signals the next move toward escape.
components.css: .ds-exit-cta { min-width: 210px; padding: 15px 24px; border: 0; border-radius: 4px; color: #101c2f; background: #24c982; box-shadow: 7px 8px 0 rgba(3, 8, 15, .4); font: 900 17px Pretendard, 'Noto Sans KR', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-exit-cta:hover { background: #47daa0; } .ds-exit-cta:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #f3e8cd; outline-offset: 3px; background: #47daa0; } .ds-exit-cta:active { transform: translate(2px, 2px); box-shadow: 5px 6px 0 rgba(3, 8, 15, .4); }

components.name: Action Control
components.description: One of the two immediate game verbs, visible as a tactile control.
components.css: .ds-action-control { min-width: 210px; height: 60px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 30px 1fr auto; gap: 8px; padding: 0 14px; border: 1px solid rgba(243, 232, 205, .36); border-radius: 7px; color: #f3e8cd; background: rgba(8, 16, 29, .68); box-shadow: 0 5px 12px rgba(3, 8, 15, .28); font-family: Pretendard, 'Noto Sans KR', system-ui, sans-serif; align-items: center; cursor: pointer; } .ds-action-control i { font-style: normal; font-size: 26px; } .ds-action-control span { font-size: 24px; font-weight: 900; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-action-control kbd { color: #f3e8cd; font-size: 12px; } .ds-action-control:hover, .ds-action-control:focus-visible { border-color: #24c982; } .ds-action-control:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #24c982; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-action-control:active { color: #101c2f; background: #ff8a1f; box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(3, 8, 15, .32); transform: translateY(2px); }

components.name: Pursuit Alert
components.description: Compact boss-distance marker with warning and escalation state.
components.css: .ds-pursuit-alert { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 30px auto; grid-template-rows: auto auto; align-items: center; gap: 0 10px; color: #f3e8cd; font-family: Pretendard, 'Noto Sans KR', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-pursuit-alert i { grid-row: 1 / 3; width: 26px; height: 26px; display: grid; place-items: center; border: 2px solid #ff8a1f; border-radius: 2px; color: #ff8a1f; font-style: normal; font-size: 15px; transform: rotate(45deg); } .ds-pursuit-alert span { color: color-mix(in srgb, #f3e8cd 70%, #101c2f); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 750; line-height: 1; } .ds-pursuit-alert b { font-size: 18px; line-height: 1.1; } .ds-pursuit-alert:hover i, .ds-pursuit-alert:hover b { color: #f04455; border-color: #f04455; } .ds-pursuit-alert:focus-within { outline: 3px solid #24c982; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Route Progress
components.description: The continuous orange-to-green escape route and active zone waypoint.
components.css: .ds-route { min-width: 300px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto; gap: 4px 12px; color: #f3e8cd; font-family: Pretendard, 'Noto Sans KR', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-route > span { font-size: 24px; font-weight: 900; letter-spacing: -.02em; } .ds-route > b { color: #24c982; font-size: 18px; align-self: end; } .ds-route > i { position: relative; grid-column: 1 / 3; height: 5px; margin: 0 6px; background: rgba(243, 232, 205, .26); } .ds-route > i em { position: absolute; inset: 0 62% 0 0; min-width: 4px; display: block; background: linear-gradient(90deg, #ff8a1f, #24c982); box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(36, 201, 130, .22); } .ds-route ol { grid-column: 1 / 3; display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; } .ds-route li { padding-top: 8px; color: rgba(243, 232, 205, .56); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 750; text-align: center; } .ds-route li.is-active { color: #f3e8cd; text-decoration: underline 2px #24c982; text-underline-offset: 4px; } .ds-route:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #24c982; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Collectible Marker
components.description: Small route pickup marker that turns green after collection.
components.css: .ds-pickup { width: 42px; height: 42px; display: inline-grid; place-items: center; border-bottom: 2px solid rgba(243, 232, 205, .32); color: rgba(243, 232, 205, .48); font: 750 11px Pretendard, 'Noto Sans KR', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-pickup.is-collected { border-color: #24c982; color: #24c982; box-shadow: 0 4px 0 -2px rgba(36, 201, 130, .24); } .ds-pickup:hover { color: #f3e8cd; } .ds-pickup:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #24c982; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Hazard Telegraph
components.description: World-attached instruction for the imminent jump or slide.
components.css: .ds-telegraph { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; color: #ff8a1f; font-family: Pretendard, 'Noto Sans KR', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 22px; text-shadow: 0 3px 8px rgba(3, 7, 13, .75); animation: ds-telegraph-pulse .5s ease-in-out infinite alternate; } .ds-telegraph i { width: 34px; height: 34px; display: grid; place-items: center; border: 2px solid currentColor; border-radius: 50%; font-style: normal; } .ds-telegraph b { font-size: 22px; letter-spacing: .02em; } .ds-telegraph:hover { filter: brightness(1.18); } .ds-telegraph:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #24c982; outline-offset: 3px; } @keyframes ds-telegraph-pulse { to { transform: translateY(-6px); filter: brightness(1.18); } }

components.name: Harin Assistance Callout
components.description: Brief ivory support cue that distinguishes assistance from an overlay card.
components.css: .ds-harin-callout { width: 150px; padding: 8px 10px; border: 1px solid rgba(36, 201, 130, .58); border-radius: 4px; color: #101c2f; background: #f3e8cd; box-shadow: 6px 7px 0 rgba(8, 15, 28, .42); font: 750 13px Pretendard, 'Noto Sans KR', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-harin-callout:hover { border-color: #24c982; box-shadow: 6px 7px 0 rgba(36, 201, 130, .28); } .ds-harin-callout:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #24c982; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Office Threshold
components.description: Translucent office portal that passes through the world to signal a zone change.
components.css: .ds-threshold { position: relative; width: 148px; height: 220px; border: 7px solid rgba(76, 96, 112, .68); border-bottom: 0; background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(116, 151, 171, .08), rgba(15, 25, 39, .2)); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(243, 232, 205, .14), 8px 0 24px rgba(3, 7, 13, .24); } .ds-threshold::after { position: absolute; right: -12px; bottom: -4px; left: -12px; height: 4px; content: ''; background: rgba(243, 232, 205, .38); } .ds-threshold i { position: absolute; top: 8%; bottom: 0; left: 50%; width: 2px; background: rgba(243, 232, 205, .2); } .ds-threshold b { position: absolute; top: 12px; left: 50%; padding: 5px 8px; color: #f3e8cd; background: rgba(8, 16, 29, .86); font: 750 13px Pretendard, 'Noto Sans KR', system-ui, sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; transform: translateX(-50%); } .ds-threshold:hover { border-color: rgba(36, 201, 130, .5); } .ds-threshold:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #24c982; outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview:
This system belongs only to the DAY 4 `부장님 피해서 퇴근하기` minigame world, not to NAN's visual-novel or story UI. It makes a single continuous office escape legible: Doyun stays grounded near the left third while hazards, landmarks, and thresholds advance from the right toward the elevator.

Night Shift Navy, Elevator Ivory, Exit Green, and Warning Orange establish a late-office emergency wayfinding world. Smoked glass, dim approved office backdrops, and floor seams produce layered photographic depth; the interface remains a game instrument, never a static-background web dashboard.
keyCharacteristics: Compact 64px status HUD above a predominantly playable world.
Physical portal and floor-line thresholds that pass the player instead of merely changing a scene.
Tactile emergency wayfinding: square-edged labels, bright route marks, and clear action states.
Fixed player framing, grounded shadows, and staged boss/Harin depth that make pursuit readable.

rules.name: The Exit Line Rule
rules.body: Carry the direction of escape through a floor-adjacent progression from Warning Orange to Exit Green; do not replace it with a detached dashboard progress treatment.

rules.name: The Impact Reserve Rule
rules.body: Impact Red belongs to danger escalation and collision only; normal calls to action remain Exit Green or Warning Orange.

rules.name: The Two-Verb Rule
rules.body: In active play, emphasize only the two player verbs—jump and slide—so the visual hierarchy never competes with the action decision.

rules.name: The Threshold-Rhythm Rule
rules.body: Zone changes must be communicated by physical doorway, corridor, gate, or elevator thresholds crossing the shared world projection—not by a whole-screen swap or a card transition.

rules.name: The Grounded Depth Rule
rules.body: Use tonal parallax and floor contact before adding surface lift; a floating dashboard card is not a substitute for world depth.

dos: Do keep Doyun fixed near the left third and move hazards, landmarks, and the exit through the shared floor baseline.
Do use the orange-to-green floor line and route indicator to make the course's escape direction visible at a glance.
Do use layered approved backdrops, smoked glass, and grounded shadows to show office depth.
Do retain both jump and slide as immediately visible, keyboard-focusable, touch-sized controls.
donts: Don't turn the active course into a static office image with dashboard cards layered on top.
Don't use the elevator as a permanent background object; make it a destination threshold that arrives in world space.
Don't use Impact Red as a decorative accent or use bright color to obscure obstacle clearance.
Don't let perspective decoration, effect placement, or visual art change collision geometry.
